objective: Al terminar demuestras lo aprendido en la unidad: hablas de tu vida, das opiniones con razones, describes cómo haces las cosas y usas los tiempos verbales aprendidos.

warmup.prompt_es: Checkpoint de la unidad 10: integra adverbios, verbos + -ing / to, opiniones, conectores y tu historia de vida.

input.recap_es: Repasa: adverbios de modo, verbos + -ing o to + verbo, dar y pedir opiniones, because / so / but / although y cómo contar tu vida con varios tiempos.

md_es: - *carefully · slowly · well · hard · fast* — *He speaks English well.*
- *enjoy / finish / mind + -ing · want / hope / decide + to + verbo*
- *I think … · In my opinion … · I agree / I don't agree · I don't think …*
- *I was born … · I've lived here for … · Next year I'm going to … · One day I'd like to …*

exercises.prompt: She speaks English very ___. (bien)

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! El adverbio de good es well.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: El adverbio de good es well.

exercises.prompt: He drives ___ because the road is icy. (con cuidado)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Careful + -ly.

exercises.prompt: En invierno hace frío.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: It's + adjetivo + in + estación.

exercises.prompt: I enjoy ___ (swim) in the sea.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Enjoy + -ing.

exercises.prompt: We decided ___ (go) by train.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Decide + to + verbo.

exercises.prompt: I don't ___ that it's a good idea. (no creo)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: I don't think …

exercises.prompt: It was raining, ___ we stayed at home. (así que)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: So introduce el resultado.

exercises.prompt: Elige la frase correcta.
options: Although it was late, we went out.
Although it was late, but we went out.
Although it was late, so we went out.
Because it was late, but we went out.
answer: Although it was late, we went out.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Although no se combina con but.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Although no se combina con but.

exercises.prompt: Tu teléfono se quedó sin batería. Necesitas un ___.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Un cargador carga la batería.

exercises.prompt: I'd like a ___ of bread, please. (una pieza entera)

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Un pan entero se cuenta como a loaf of bread.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Un pan entero se cuenta como a loaf of bread.

exercises.prompt: Elige la frase correcta.
options: I have gone to Paris in 2019.
I have went to Paris in 2019.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Con in 2019 (tiempo terminado) se usa pasado simple.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Con in 2019 (tiempo terminado) se usa pasado simple.

exercises.prompt: Will you help me? — Yes, I ___.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Respuesta corta afirmativa: Yes, I will.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Respuesta corta afirmativa: Yes, I will.

exercises.prompt: Elige la frase correcta.
options: I was born in 1995 and I've lived here since 2019.
I am born in 1995 and I live here since 2019.
I born in 1995 and I've lived here for 2019.
I was born in 1995 and I live here since 2019.
answer: I was born in 1995 and I've lived here since 2019.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Was born + present perfect con since.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Was born + present perfect con since.

exercises.prompt: En el trabajo, el uniforme es gratis y no es necesario comprarlo. Dices:
options: I don't have to buy it.
answer: I don't have to buy it.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! No es necesario = don't have to.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: No es necesario = don't have to.

exercises.prompt: ¿Cuántos huevos necesitamos?
answer: How many eggs do we need?

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Eggs es contable: how many.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Después del verbo: well.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Want + to + verbo.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.
exercises.text: I stayed home because the rain.
answer: I stayed home because of the rain.
I stayed at home because of the rain.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Sustantivo → because of.

exercises.prompt: I like ___ music. (en general)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: En general, sin artículo.

exercises.prompt: ¿Qué disfruta la persona?
exercises.audio_text: I think that learning English is useful because I can travel more easily. Although it's difficult, I enjoy studying every day.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice 'I enjoy studying every day'.

exercises.prompt: Creo que es una buena idea porque es barato, aunque es un poco lejos.
answer: I think it's a good idea because it's cheap, although it's a bit far.
I think it is a good idea because it is cheap, although it is a bit far.
I think it's a good idea because it's cheap, although it's a little far.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Opinión + because + although.

exercises.prompt: Escribe un párrafo de 6 a 8 frases presentándote para cerrar esta unidad: de dónde eres, qué hiciste, qué haces ahora, qué opinas de aprender inglés y qué quieres hacer en el futuro.
self_check_es: ¿Hablaste del futuro (going to / I'd like to)?
exercises.model_answer: I was born in Santa Fe and I studied business. I've worked in an office for two years. I enjoy working with people, but I'm not very good at maths. I think that English is important because I want to travel. Although it's difficult, I study every day. Next year I'm going to take a course, and one day I'd like to work abroad.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.

choices: I'm going to study English. I want to travel, so I think it's important.
Next year I study English. I want travel so important.

choices: Yes, I do. Although it's difficult, I enjoy it.
